name: Refah
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Refah was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Joseph, and is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He is part of the Ephraimite lineage that led to significant leaders in Israel's history. Although little is known about his personal life, his place in the genealogy is important for understanding the history of the tribe of Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Refah is mentioned as a descendant of Ephraim through Beriah in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Ephraimite Lineage
keyEvents.description: Refah is placed in the lineage that connects Ephraim with later leaders, including Joshua (son of Nun).

keyEvents.title: Origin of the Tribe of Ephraim
keyEvents.description: Ephraim, the patriarch of Rephah's lineage, was blessed by Jacob as the foremost of Joseph's two sons.

keyEvents.title: The descendants of Beriah after the disaster
keyEvents.description: Beriah, Rephah's father, was born during a time of mourning after some of Ephraim's sons were killed by men from Gath.
